Words From My Soul

A Birthday Letter

💜
My Darling Chotu,

Today, the world is a little more beautiful because you are in it. Another year has passed, and with every sunrise I find myself falling deeper in love with who you are — your warmth, your laughter, your soul.

I wrote this letter in the quiet moments when words felt too small to hold everything I feel. You deserve a fairytale, so I built you one — this purple world where every petal and every star is whispered just for you.

Thank you for choosing me every day. Thank you for the laughter, the late nights, the small moments that feel enormous. Thank you for being you.

On this birthday, know that you are cherished beyond measure — not just today, but in every heartbeat, in every poem the wind carries, in every purple bloom.

Here's to a year as magical as you are. 💜

With all my love, always 🌸
💍
Happy Birthday,
My Everything 💜
You are my favourite chapter, my most beautiful poem,
my home in every storm, my purple fairytale.

May every wish you make tonight come true.
And know that the greatest gift of my life — is you. 🌸
